### Twenty One Capital CEO, Raphael Zagury, to Participate in Panel Discussion at the 4th Annual Cantor Convergence Conference on November 10th


November 4, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/307816567/files/doc_news/Twenty-One-Capital-CEO-Raphael-Zagury-to-Participate-in-Panel-Discussion-at-the-4th-Annual-Cantor-Convergence-Conference-on-November--R0BKF.pdf)


AUSTIN, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Twenty One Capital, Inc. (“Twenty One” or “XXI”) (NYSE: XXI), today announced that Chief Executive Officer Raphael Zagury will participate in a panel discussion titled “Beyond a DAT: The Growing Digital Economy” at Cantor Convergence: 4th Annual Crypto, Fintech, AI & Energy Infrastructure Conference, taking place November 10–12, 2026, at The Ritz-Carlton, South Beach in Miami, Florida.


**Cantor Convergence: 4th Annual Crypto, Fintech, AI & Energy Infrastructure Conference**


- **Dates:** November 10-12, 2026
- **Location:** The Ritz-Carlton South Beach, Miami, Florida
- **Panel:** “Beyond a DAT: The Growing Digital Economy”


- **Date and Time:** November 12, 2026, 1:15 p.m. ET
- **Panelists:**


- Raphael Zagury, Chief Executive Officer, Twenty One Capital
- Joseph Chalom, Chief Executive Officer, Sharplink Inc
- Mark Brazier, Chief Financial Officer, Forward Industries Inc


To schedule a one-on-one meeting with Twenty One’s management team during the conference please email KCSA Strategic Communications atXXI@KCSA.com .


**About Twenty One** Twenty One is a Bitcoin-focused operating company. Designed to pair one of the largest Bitcoin treasuries in the public markets with operating businesses, Twenty One aims to provide shareholders with direct, capital-efficient exposure to Bitcoin through a growing Bitcoin-native platform. For more information, visit[https://investors.xxi.money/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.xxi.money%2F&esheet=54634345&newsitemid=20261104309964&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.xxi.money%2F&index=1&md5=b9fd7068efd756d17e9089a841fc1348) .
